metadata.name: BMO Progressbar
metadata.description: Adds a dancing BMO to the Progress Bar.

files.index.css: .player-controls .playback-progressbar::before { content: ''; width: 45px; height: 45px; bottom: calc(100% - 6px); right: 10px; position: absolute; image-rendering: high-quality; background-size: 45px 45px; background-image: url('https://64.media.tumblr.com/38ff0368992c9f601ee746469f9a19c1/tumblr_mqf4asbozS1qmkil9o1_500.gif'); }
